title: #gutenberg #gutenbergthemusical #gutenbergbway #gutenbergbroadway #gu...
transcript: Last night I saw Gutenberg the musical on Broadway starring Josh Gad and Andrew Reynolds. Going into this, I knew it was about a musical within a musical related to the man who invented the printing press. What I didn't know is that the show is literally just Josh Gad and Andrew Reynolds plus the three musicians on stage. The two characters, Bud and Doug, are basically presenting to us audience members a bare bones workshop production of the musical they've written about Gutenberg, which they describe as historical fiction. The show is good. The physical comedy is good. The different voices they use are funny, and there are some very funny theory jokes in it. That said, I don't think the material is particularly memorable. I mostly think it's just a decent vehicle for Josh Gad and Andrew Reynolds to be funny together on stage. So if that's your expectation, you will not be disappointed. Gutenberg, I believe, is running through January 2024. The James Earl Jones Theater. With that, another playbill for my collection.
